description_en: Creates a file for a function in DataStudio
description_zh: 调用CreateUdfFile，在数据开发中创建函数类型文件
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-udf-file --file-folder-path Business_process/First_Business_Process/function/string_processing --project-id 10000 --file-name StringConcat --function-type STRING --class-name com.alibaba.DataWorks.api.udf.StringConcat --resources string-concat-1.0.0.jar,commons-lang-2.6.jar --udf-description Concatenate_several_strings_to_generate_a_new_string --cmd-description StringConcat_String..._substrs --parameter-description List_of_strings_to_be_connected --return-value New_strings_generated_by_concatenating_all_strings_before_and_after_the_input_order --example StringConcat_a_,_b_,_c --project-identifier dw_project --create-folder-if-not-exists false --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUdfFile

parameters.help_en: The path of the folder in which the file for the function is stored
parameters.help_zh: 函数文件所在的文件夹路径
parameters.name: file_folder_path

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the Workspace Manage icon in the upper-right corner of the DataStudio page to go to the Workspace Management page and view the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the file for the function
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the function. Valid values: MATH, AGGREGATE, STRING, DATE, ANALYTIC, and OTHER. This parameter corresponds to the Function Type parameter in the Register Function section of the configuration tab of the function on the DataStudio page
parameters.help_zh: 函数的分类，对应创建函数表单中的函数类型一项，包括MATH（数学运算函数）、AGGREGATE（聚合函数）、STRING（字符串处理函数）、DATE（日期处理函数）、ANALYTIC（窗口函数）和OTHER（其他函数）
parameters.name: function_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the class in which the function is defined. This parameter corresponds to the Class Name parameter in the Register Function section of the configuration tab of the function in the DataWorks console
parameters.help_zh: 函数定义所在的类名，对应创建函数表单的类名一项
parameters.name: class_name

parameters.help_en: The names of the resources that are referenced by the function. This parameter corresponds to the Resources parameter in the Register Function section of the configuration tab of the function in the DataWorks console. Multiple resource names are separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 函数引用的资源名列表，对应创建表中的资源列表。多个资源名称之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resources

parameters.example: Concatenate several strings to generate a new string
parameters.help_en: The description of the function. This parameter corresponds to the Description parameter in the Register Function section of the configuration tab of the function on the DataStudio page
parameters.help_zh: 函数用途的说明，对应创建函数表单中的描述
parameters.name: udf_description

parameters.help_en: The syntax used for calling the function. This parameter corresponds to the Expression Syntax parameter in the Register Function section of the configuration tab of the function in the DataWorks console
parameters.help_zh: 函数调用的命令格式，对应创建函数表单中的命令格式
parameters.name: cmd_description

parameters.example: List of strings to be connected
parameters.help_en: The description of the input parameters of the function. This parameter corresponds to the Parameter Description parameter in the Register Function section of the configuration tab of the function on the DataStudio page
parameters.help_zh: 函数入参的说明，对应创建函数表单中的参数说明
parameters.name: parameter_description

parameters.example: New strings generated by concatenating all strings before and after the input order
parameters.help_en: The description of the return value of the function. This parameter corresponds to the Return Value parameter in the Register Function section of the configuration tab of the function on the DataStudio page
parameters.help_zh: 函数的返回值说明，对应创建函数表单中的返回值
parameters.name: return_value

parameters.help_en: The example for calling the function. This parameter corresponds to the Example parameter in the Register Function section of the configuration tab of the function in the DataWorks console
parameters.help_zh: 函数调用示例，对应创建函数表单中的示例
parameters.name: example

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the identifier in the upper-left corner of the DataStudio page to switch to another workspace.

You must specify either this parameter or the projectId parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is called
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically create the directory that is specified by the FileFolderPath parameter if the directory does not exist. Valid values:

*   true: The system automatically creates the directory if the directory does not exist.
*   false: The system does not automatically create the directory if the directory does not exist. In this case, the call fails
parameters.help_zh:
当参数中指定的目录（FileFolderPath）在系统中不存在时，是否自动创建此目录。取值如下：

- true：若此目录不存在，自动创建此目录

- false：若此目录不存在，调用失败
parameters.name: create_folder_if_not_exists
